description: This file contains functions for checking and performing system image upgrades, including partition layout verification, copying configurations, and writing images to devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of an upgrade image against the current device, and aborts if there are differences unless confirmed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to a specific partition on the device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by comparing partition layouts, writing images to device partitions, and updating device UUID.
